summary_en: This note explains the method of termwise estimation for sums, products, and integrals, with emphasis on controlling accumulated error and simplifying the resulting expression. It surveys common use cases such as bounding sums, evaluating parameter-dependent limits, testing convergence, and combining termwise bounds with Taylor expansion, telescoping, and partitioning.

problems.statement_en: Prove that for any real numbers \(a,b,c\), \((a+b+c)^2\geq 3(ab+bc+ac)\).

For \(S_N:=\sum_{n=1}^{2N}(-1)^n f(n)\), derive bounds via pairing and convexity/concavity: if \(f\) is concave, then \(\frac{f(2N+1)-f(1)}{2}\le S_N\le \frac{f(2N)-f(0)}{2}\); for convex \(f\), the inequalities reverse.
problems.statement_zh: 如果\(S_N:=\sum_{n=1}^{2N}(-1)^{n}f(n)\)，通过奇偶配对与凸凹性可得到：若\(f\)具有concave性，则\(\frac{f(2N+1)-f(1)}{2}\leq S_N\leq \frac{f(2N)-f(0)}{2}\)；若\(f\)具有convex性，则不等式反向。

problems.statement_en: Prove that for every positive integer \(N\), \(1+\frac{1}{2!}+\cdots+\frac{1}{N!}<3\).
Estimate \(S=\sum_{k=1}^{40}\sqrt{400+k}\) with error as small as possible, expected in particular to be less than \(1\).
problems.statement_zh: 对\(S=\sum_{k=1}^{40}\sqrt{400+k}\)做一个误差尽可能小，且预计误差不会超过1的估计。

problems.statement_en: Study the asymptotic behavior of \(S_n:=\sum_{k\le n}\sin(k/n^2)\).
problems.statement_zh: 求含参数和\(S_n:=\sum_{k\leq n}\sin(k/n^2)\)的渐近展开或极限。

problems.statement_en: Compute the limit of \(S_n:=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{1}{n^2}\sqrt{(n+k)(n+k+1)}\).
Compute the limit of \(S_n:=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\left(1-\frac{k}{n}\right)^n\).
Compute the limit of \(S_n:=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{5^{k/n}}{n+1/k}\).

For nonnegative terms \(y_i(p)\), determine the limit of \(\left(\sum_{i\le n} y_i(p)\right)^{1/p}\) as \(p\to\infty\) by reducing to the maximal term; the same idea also applies when the number of terms varies with \(p\) and when fixed nonnegative weights are present.
problems.statement_zh: 对于求\(\left(\sum_{i\leq n}y_i(p)\right)^{1/p},p\to +\infty\)的极限，只需要关注其中最大的那一项；若求和上限随\(p\)变化且\(n_p^{1/p}\to1\)，或加入固定非负权重，结论仍然成立。

problems.statement_en: Compute \(\lim_{n\to\infty}(1+n)^{1/n}\).
Compute the limit of \(x_n:=\sqrt[n]{1+\sqrt{2}+\sqrt[3]{3}+\cdots+\sqrt[n]{n}}\).
Prove that \(\lim_{p\to\infty}(x_1^p+\cdots+x_n^p)^{1/p}=\max\{x_1,\dots,x_n\}\).
Prove that the weighted power mean satisfies \(\lim_{p\to +\infty} M_p(x_1,\dots,x_n;w_1,\dots,w_n)=\max\{x_1,\dots,x_n\}\).
problems.statement_zh: 证明加权\(p\)次平均值满足\(\lim_{p \rightarrow +\infty} M_{p}(x_1,...,x_n;w_1 \cdots w_n) = \max\{x_1,...,x_n\}\)。

problems.statement_en: Show that the Euler product \(\prod_p \frac{1}{1-p^{-s}}\) converges absolutely for \(\mathrm{Re}(s)>1\).
problems.statement_zh: 判断\(\displaystyle{\prod_{p}}{\frac{1}{1-p^{-s}}},\text{Re}(s)>1\)\)的收敛性，并证明其绝对收敛。

problems.statement_en: Show that \(\int_{0}^{\pi}\frac{|\sin((N+\frac12)t)|}{t}\,dt\) is unbounded, in fact \(\int_{0}^{\pi}\frac{|\sin((N+\frac12)t)|}{t}\,dt=\frac{2}{\pi}\log N+O(1)\).
problems.statement_zh: 证明\(\int_{0}^{\pi}\frac{\left|\sin\left((N+\frac{1}{2})t\right)\right|}{t}dt\)不是有界的，并得到估计\(\frac{2}{\pi}\log(N)+O(1)\)。

problems.statement_en: Assuming \(\sum_{n\ge1}|a_n|<\infty\), prove that \(f(x):=\sum_{n\ge1}\frac{|a_n|}{\sqrt{|x-r_n|}}\) is finite almost everywhere.
problems.statement_zh: 证明\(f(x):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{|a_n|}{\sqrt{|x-r_n|}}\)几乎处处有限（在\(\sum_{n\ge1}|a_n|<\infty\)的条件下）。

problems.statement_en: Estimate \(S_n:=\sum_{k\le n} n^{1/k}\) with target precision \(o(n)\).
problems.statement_zh: 估计\(S_n:=\sum_{k\leq n}n^{1/k}\)，并达到\(o(n)\)的精度。

problems.statement_en: Compute the limit \(\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}\log(1+k/n^2)\).
Determine for which values of \(a,b\) the series associated with \(u_n:=\log n+a\log(n+1)+b\log(n+2)\) converges.
problems.statement_zh: 确定参数\(a,b\)取什么值的时候，序列\(u_n:=\log(n)+a\log(n+1)+b\log(n+2)\)对应的级数是收敛的。

problems.statement_en: Determine the convergence of \(\sum_{n\ge2}\frac{(-1)^n}{\sqrt{n}+(-1)^n}\).
Estimate \(S_n:=\sum_{i\le n}\frac{1}{n+\sqrt{i}}\) with precision \(o(1/\sqrt{n})\).
Show that the Taylor-expansion-based termwise method fails for \(\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{1}{n+f(k)}\) with \(f(k):=\frac{2k(k-1)}{2k-1}\), when trying to compute its limit.
problems.statement_zh: 说明对含参数和\(\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{1}{n+f(k)}\)（其中\(f(k):=\frac{2k(k-1)}{2k-1}\)）求极限时，仅基于Taylor展开的逐项估计方法不适用。

problems.statement_en: For \(p>0\), prove that \(\int_0^1 \frac{1}{1+x^p}\,dx>\frac{p}{p+1}\).
Compute the asymptotics of \(I_n:=n\int_0^1 \log\left(1+\frac{e^x}{n}\right)dx\), in particular its limit.
key_techniques: Taylor expansion under the integral sign

problems.statement_en: Prove that \(\int_0^1 \log(1+x^5)\,dx>\frac{1}{10}\).
Prove that for every positive integer \(n\), \(\int_0^1 e^{-nx^2}\,dx > \frac{1}{2\sqrt{n}}\).
problems.statement_zh: 证明对任意正整数\(n\)都有\(\int_0^1 e^{-nx^2}\,dx >\frac{1}{2\sqrt{n}}\)。

problems.statement_en: Let \(J_n:=\int_0^1 \frac{\log(1+x/n)}{x}\,dx\). Compute \(\lim_{n\to\infty} n|nJ_n-1|\).
key_techniques: Taylor expansion under the integral sign

problems.statement_en: Estimate \(A(s):=\sum_{k=1}^{N(s)-1}\frac{1}{x_kx_{k+1}}\), where \(x_k(s)\) is the \(k\)-th positive root of \(\cos x=sx\).
problems.statement_zh: 估计和\(A(s):=\sum_{k=1}^{N(s)-1}\frac{1}{x_kx_{k+1}}\)，其中\(x_k(s)\)是方程\(\cos(x)=sx\)的从小到大的第\(k\)个正实根。

problems.statement_en: Estimate \(S_N=\frac{1}{N^2}\sum_{n\le N} n\log n-\frac12\log N\).
problems.statement_zh: 对\(S_N=\frac{1}{N^2}\sum_{n\leq N} n\log(n)-\frac{1}{2}\log(N)\)做渐近估计。

problems.statement_en: Estimate \(R_n:=\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt-\frac1n\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}f(k/n)\) with precision \(o(1/n)\).

key_techniques_discussed: termwise estimation for sums, products, and integrals
using convexity or concavity of finite differences
partitioning the index set before termwise estimates
Taylor expansion with explicit remainder control
turning products into sums via logarithms
estimating differences by rewriting them as sums or integrals term by term
using Lipschitz or mean-value inequalities for termwise bounds
using implicit-function asymptotics inside a sum
